title: 10 games worth your time on Legion Go 2
hook: Handheld gamers, this is the list. Ten incredible Legion Go two games. Wait for number one.
post_text: Ten incredible handheld games. Which one is your number one? Follow for more handheld gaming picks. Editorial ranking, not an FPS benchmark. Independent and unsponsored; game footage belongs to the respective publishers.
